items.title: Joe Williams interviewed by Leslie Gourse, New York City, New York, March 9, 1996
items.q: as Sam Snead said once when he was on the practice range

ctx.x: You can contemplate and consider and make adjustments and what have you to see how, as Sam Snead said once when he was on the practice range, somebody said, “Oh you’re trying to get it together, Sam?” He said, “No, if you’re trying to get it together you have no business out here. I just want to see how I’m hitting it today.”
